senses.gloss:
स स, originally ‘One.’
 I. See तद्; in the Vedas appears also the loc. सस्मिन्.
 II. As former part of comp. nouns.
 1. With; see स-कमल, adj. With lotus flowers.
 2. The same, like, equal; see स-धर्मन्, adj. Of the same caste, etc.
 --Cf. σ in σήμερον, ὁ, ἡ, οἱ, αἱ, ἑ in ἕεις, εἷς (e. g. in ἑ-ϝενς), ἁ- (e. g. in ἁ-πλοῦς), ἀ- (e. g. in ἀδελϕός), ὀ- (e. g. in ὄ-πατρος); Lat. sum = eum, sam = eam, -sum, sem- in semper, sim- in simplex; Goth. sa, so; A.S. se, seo.
